Package aor.proj3t.util.converterutils

Class MiniUserConverter

java.lang.Object
aor.proj3t.util.converterutils.MiniUserConverter
@ApplicationScoped public class MiniUserConverter extends Object
Converter class for transforming User entities into compact DTOs.

Provides utilities to convert individual and collections of User objects into MiniUserDTO, which contain only essential user details such as ID, name, email, and profile photograph. These are typically used for lightweight views, dropdowns, and contexts where full user data isn't necessary.
